features.name: Rob Roy Inn, Roadside Of Kinneff
features.fullDescription: Plain two storey, harl and slate. Probably dating late 18th century. Single-storey addition at rear.

features.fullDescription: Small oblong. Norman with belfry and projecting porch. Rubble and slate. Former Free Kirk 1843 (dated).
